selection: Synopsis Section 4.9 initial weights and Section 4.9 tiers (>85% strong, 70-85% moderate, <70% weak similarity). The tiers are heuristic display thresholds, not calibrated probabilities. Text 'tfidf' selects the fixed-vocabulary lexical release named in text_release (term frequency x fixed per-class term weights shipped with the release, title + description, concept normalisation); it is no longer fitted on the candidate pool. ResNet-50 images. The pilot-tuned weight variant recorded in earlier results is an experiment only: the constructed pilot fails the research-readiness gate, so it must not override the synopsis defaults in production.

changes.synopsis-v3: Stable pairwise lexical text model (lexical-v1) over title + description; graded chronology with time of day (no hard found-before-lost exclusion); multicolour-aware colour comparison; evidence coverage with coverage- and chronology-based tier caps; matches retired instead of deleted.
changes.synopsis-v2: Image similarity calibrated above each model's chance level.

missing_data_policy: Components with no evidence on one or both reports (no photo or an unprocessed photo; no brand and no colour on both; no usable text; no date) are dropped and the remaining weights renormalised. Dropped components and the evidence coverage (share of base weight compared) are stored per match; coverage below 0.70 caps the tier at moderate, below 0.50 at weak.
temporal_rule: Graded chronology, never a hard exclusion: plausible (found on/after lost), approximate (found up to 1 day earlier on dates alone, or up to 3 hours earlier when both times are known; penalty x0.9), suspicious (earlier than that, up to 7 days; penalty x0.5, tier capped at moderate, moderator warning), contradictory (more than 7 days earlier; date score 0, tier capped at weak, warning).
image_calibration: Raw image cosine is rescaled above each model's chance level: (cos - chance) / (1 - chance), clamped to [0, 1]. Chance is the median cosine between photos of different items (the 120 label-0 pairs of evaluation/pilot/dataset.json) with the pinned models: ResNet-50 0.275, CLIP 0.568, histogram 0.574. Without it, unrelated photos scored 0.25-0.57 and added unearned points to every pair; identical photos still score 1.
